normative_validator: Existing scientific_score.normalize_case_response and reporting_core.validate_rows; this document does not implement another validator.
transport: Exactly one UTF-8 JSON object on stdout; diagnostics on stderr.

object.case_id: Copy the string from the current /input/request.json.
object.workbook_sha256: Copy the string from the current /input/request.json.

rows.pearson_r: Finite JSON number in[-1,1]: random-effects correlation on the Pearson-r scale.
rows.p_two_sided: Finite JSON number in[0,1]: original two-sided uncorrected p-value.
rows.k: Finite integer-valued JSON number with1<=k<=N: fitted-model study count.
rows.N: Finite integer-valued JSON number withN>=k>=1: source sample-size sum for the fitted contrast.

invalid: Null, Boolean or string values in numeric fields
Invalid correlation, p-value or count ranges
Changed routing identity or input hash
Additional text around the JSON object
evaluator_only: Authoritative selection of scoring policy and target operands; the fixed policy identifier and rules are public.

public_scoring_rule.comparison: Open nearest-reporting bins; k/N exact. Exact candidate boundary or unresolved reference bin is indeterminate.
public_scoring_rule.criterion_is_not: Numerical estimator-error bound, statistical confidence interval, or R print-string match.
